# OBD2 SCAN AI — ИИ-Автосканер и Диагност

> OBD2 SCAN AI is an AI-driven OBD-II diagnostics and vehicle troubleshooting platform for drivers, mechanics, and autonomous diagnostic agents.
> OBD2 SCAN AI — интеллектуальная диагностика автомобилей через OBD-II сканеры ELM327 и нейросетевой анализ кодов DTC.

## Capabilities / Возможности
- OBD-II fault code (DTC) reading and interpretation (P0300, P0171, P0420, etc.).
- Step-by-step repair guides and symptom-based diagnostic assistance.
- Torque specs calculator and automotive component troubleshooting.
- Cross-platform support for Android (APK) and Windows PC.

## Discovery Endpoints / Эндпоинты
- Website: https://obd2scanai.ru/
- API Catalog: https://obd2scanai.ru/.well-known/api-catalog
- OpenAPI Spec: https://obd2scanai.ru/api/openapi.json
- MCP Server Card: https://obd2scanai.ru/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Agent Skills Index: https://obd2scanai.ru/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Protected Resource: https://obd2scanai.ru/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- Authorization Server: https://obd2scanai.ru/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- Agent Registration: https://obd2scanai.ru/auth.md
